notes.title: New game update: 1.14.0
notes.notes:
Hey people! It is being a while, but I've been working hard all this time! This update comes with many improvements from player's feedback, mostly quality of life improvements.



Changelog:

Combat Options (options on the right side of the action bar + options on the bottom-right corner of the screen)

UI

Changed icons and the UI

Icon showing the currently selected option

Text showing the command

Tooltips

Mechanics

Strike Styles:

Adjustments to bonuses and penalties

Increased damage of straight attacks, lower hit chance, higher damage variability

Random Style: the chance to pick a style is now 50% (no weapon-specific chances)

Dual wielding: both attacks are now restricted to the same style (+ new double straight attack animation)

Defense Priority:

Blocking defenses have a bonus against swing attacks

No penalties; no block after a dodge when dodge is selected

Give up attack to defend: more safety time when attacking while being attacked

Combat stance animations specific to each Strike Style

Combat Modes

Strong: 10% attack penalty

Defensive: allows attacks (with penalty), causes hesitation

Combat stance animations specific to each Combat Mode

Perforation damage now scales 50% less with Strength. This improves the Fast Attack mode, as strike strength reduction does not lower the damage as much.

Options

Invert mouse x/y

Brightness

Buttons on sliders

Font/UI size

Auto-highlight interactables (default option, only shows the name of the interactable)

UI

Game Paused indicator

UIMode key indicator

HP indicator below the creature’s name

Scrollbar in resolution dropdown (when it is long enough)

Hyperlinks: highlighted interactable text which opens a description when clicked

Improved target switching in Free Cam Mode

Accuracy shown on mouse pointer when hovering over an enemy

Added command keys to tooltips of the left-side icons

Audio

Audio pauses when the game is paused

Music volume reduced during cinematic dialogues

Party

Companion aggro range reduced

Map

Map icons: quest target, companion, NPC, merchant, region

Custom markers

Tutorial

Starting tutorial with the basics, training with Allan

Tutorial panel reorganized into a tree view

New entries

Most tutorial messages now appear at rest places

Plenty of minor bugfixes and imporvements of all kinds



A second update: the first area of Chapter 1 was developed, but it is not included in the demo. It contains new enemies, like barbarians, goblins, a juvenile dragon, and, of course, stronger cultists. After this update, I will focus again on developing Chapter 1, so you won't see updates for some time here on Steam.

notes.title: New Update: 1.7.0
notes.notes:
Hello Elengardians! This update comes with with the manual combat and some new effect mechanics!

Changelog:


 Manual combat: a new game mode that requires you to click for each attack and hold the right mouse button to defend. The game mechanics remain the same. This is still not the mentioned Action Mode. The survey was updated to reflect this change.
 	New states/effects
 		Torpor mechanics: torpor is now a generic state that can be caused by anything. It reduces Strength, defenses and willpower. When torpor level reaches 100%, the target is unconscious. Current Asyum spells use torpor mechanics now.
 		Daze mechanics: daze is a generic state that can be caused by anything. It reduces Motor Skills and adds a chance for the character to fall. It is currently caused by Electric Stun
 		Electric Stun: electric damage may cause Electric Stun, which causes Daze and may make the target unconscious
 		Weapon overweight: now the character can always hold a weapon with one hand (no forced two hand grip), but there are penalties
 	Balancing/adjustments:
 		Reduced damage of some weapons
 		Reduced chance of consecutive staggers
 		Decreased attack of area attacks
 		Increased stamina per dodge
 		Decreased speed gain from strength
 		Changed prerequisites of melee attack abilities)
 	Bugfixes
 		Exploit to use some combat modes with the bow
 		Motor skills was increasing attack range instead of decreasing it
 		Effect tooltip issue with multiple effects

notes.title: New update: 1.6.0
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! This update comes with changes on stamina and combat modes to make the combat feel more dynamic. You start now with 4 combat modes, as originally intended.

Changelog:


 Gameplay and abilities
 		Increased stamina regen, attack, defense and sprint stamina costs. There is less waiting time now.
 		Running now consumes a bit of stamina (less than stamina regen)
 		Player now starts with combat modes Fast, Strong, Aggressive and Defensive, as originally intended
 		Combat mode changes:
 			Strong: reduced attack speed penalty
 			Fast: slightly decreased Strike Strength penalty. Stamina per strike is no longer decreased
 			Aggressive: increased attack bonus and defense penalty. Added an Inertia after deactivating (it stays active for 2 seconds after the deactivate command), to improve strategic use
 			Defensive: now provides some Dodge Defense bonus in addition to Block Defense bonus
 		Basic Melee attack delay reduced
 		Reduced Constitution-to-muscles visual effect for Constitution higher than 130
 		Cost to increase Melee Attack is 100 up to 65 points
 	Bugfixes
 		issue with picking up items from loot and ordering to open the loot container
 		resetting cursor on death
 		loading invalid save
 		left hand grip still attached to weapon after death sometimes
 		properly updating the Fast Attack mode check (to see if it is allowed due to weapon weight) when switching grip mode

notes.title: New update: 1.5.0
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! This update comes to add no mouse pointer interactions. They work both on UI Mode and Free Look Mode, but were meant to the Free Look Mode. Mouse pointer interactions still work the same way on Free Look Mode.

List of changes:


 New features:
 		No mouse pointer interactions 
 			now you can perform default interactions with game elements by getting near of them and pressing the Interact key. Affected elements: loot, open containers, dialogue, pick items, rest. Mouse pointer interactions still work with UI Mode.
 			key E is now a generic Interact action, rather than just attack the selected target. If the target is hostile, the PC (player character) will attack. If not and if it has an available dialogue, the PC will talk to it. 		Switch selected target by dragging the rigth mouse button, on Free Look Mode
 	Other changes:
 		when area attacks mode is activated, only swing attacks are used now
 	Bugfixes:
 		hit sound not playing sometimes, after gainin Weakspot Focus
 		rest place bed not highlighting

notes.title: New update: 1.4.0
notes.notes:
Hello Elengardians! Here is another update with some improvements, including AI, balancing, and bugfixes.

List of changes:


 Improvements:
 		periodical autosave
 		improved some animations (boar's dodge, 1 attack of weapon and shield stance, weak stagger in some stances, defensive stance)
 		added key bindings for Switch Cam Mode and UI Mode
 		AI:
 			improved AI to possibly attack when recovering stamina and its enemy is attacking with a bow or casting a spell
 			low intelligence creatures (like wild animals) now attack more often even with low stamina
 			increased awareness range of enemies when an ally of them is attacked
 	Bugfixes:
 		rare issue with ability configuration parameters on the configuration panel not synchronizing correctly with the real parameters when opening the configuration panel
 		clicking to use and ability on Free Look Mode was also selecting a target
 		being staggered while force pushing was not starting the cooldown. Now the cooldown was starts on the cast event, not the ability end
 		corrected display text of some keyboard keys
 		no equip sounds in character creation after selecting a preset
 	Balancing:
 		Distracting orb now more easily distracts beasts
 		Feyzir projectile: increased plasma cost, decreased min conjuring time for max power
 		Increased Feyzir Orb damage (from 20 to 30), increased max power to 2x, increase plasma cost for max power. If you have a save with this spell on the bar it will still show max power 1.5, just removed it and assign it again to show 2.
 		Reduced Plasma Regeneration
 		slightly nerfed dagger swing attack damage
 		reduced xp scale (from 1.8 to 1.5)
 		increased cost to increase combat skills with higher scores
 	Other changes
 		changed default key binding for switch cam mode to Numpad Enter

notes.title: Demo launched and development update #1!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I am glad to announce that the first playable demo has been launched! The game is currently on a pre-alpha development stage, near to reaching alpha stage.
This demo aims to provide a gameplay sample of the game with the minimal features expected to be in the final game. All content is not final, especially the audiovisual assets, but even so, the demo contents can provide a fair notion of the game’s proposal. 

Give it a try and let a feedback here or on Discord!

The main changes and improvements expected for the future are:

- Adding new abilities: the ability trees are incomplete, even the ones for Soldier and Wizard, which are currently the ones with more abilities. Also, the game is expected to have superpowerfull abilities, since one of the main goals is to give the players the possibility to create demigod-like characters, in terms of power.

- Improving UI, especially the icons: ability icons are not in tune with the expected graphics style and will be replaced.

- Improving character models: they are going to be replaced by more realistic ones.

- Adding more non-human creatures: many mythological creatures are expected to be added, emphasizing dragons, elemental spirits and reptile-bird hybrids.

- Custom soundtrack

There are also plans for adding a “Soft Survival” system, in which you spend time for Rest Place actions, like learning knowledges and abilities, and passing time requires supplies to survive. Other possible additions are a lot of minor changes and improvements on the combat mechanics. But all of these will depend on the game’s reception and the speed of the development.

For now, the roadmap is:
1)	Marketing, gathering feedback, demo maintenance
2)	Review and design the remaining game features and the game levels
3)	Investigate the possibility of crowdfunding
4)	Implement the levels
5)	Implement the final features and improvements
Steps 4 and 5 are interchangeable.

Feel free to get in touch for any questions and suggestions!

Stèphano M. M. G.
